description: Source code for trace2 destination handling in Git, including file management, socket connections, and trace file creation logic.

methods.name: tr2_dst_want_warning
methods.description: Checks if debug warnings are enabled based on environment variable.

methods.name: tr2_dst_trace_disable
methods.description: Disables tracing by closing the file descriptor and resetting state.

methods.name: tr2_dst_too_many_files
methods.description: Checks if the target directory has too many files or if a sentinel file exists, managing file count and sentinel creation.

methods.name: tr2_dst_try_auto_path
methods.description: Attempts to create a trace file in an auto-named path, handling file count limits.

methods.name: tr2_dst_try_path
methods.description: Attempts to open a specified path for tracing.

methods.name: tr2_dst_try_unix_domain_socket
methods.description: Attempts to connect to a Unix domain socket for tracing.

methods.name: tr2_dst_malformed_warning
methods.description: Logs a warning for malformed trace target values.

methods.name: tr2_dst_get_trace_fd
methods.description: Determines and returns the file descriptor for tracing based on environment variable.

methods.name: tr2_dst_trace_want
methods.description: Returns whether tracing is enabled based on the trace file descriptor.

methods.name: tr2_dst_write_line
methods.description: Writes a line to the trace destination, handling errors and signals.
